Title: Azure Media Services now supports Live Transcription preview in additional regions

Body.Content:
Azure Media Services provides a platform which you can use to ingest, transcode, and dynamically package and encrypt your live video for delivery via industry-standard protocols like HLS and MPEG-DASH.  

Live transcription public preview is now available in many more regions and more languages than when first announced.

Here is the complete list of available regions:

  • Southeast Asia
  • West Europe
  • North Europe
  • East US
  • Central US
  • South Central US
  • West US 2
  • Brazil South

See complete region availability for Azure Media Services v3.

See updated documentation
